```{mermaid}
%%| fig-width: 9
%%| fig-cap: "Processing steps flowchart"
%%| label: fig-method-flowchart
%%| echo: true
%%| code-fold: true
%%{init: {"flowchart": {"padding": 8, "nodeSpacing": 30, "rankSpacing": 40, "diagramPadding": 4}} }%%
flowchart TD

    A["Study sample<br/>191 participants<br/>× 8 protocol days<br/><b>1528 participant-days</b>"]

    B1["Eye-level position<br/>143 participants<br/><b>1136 participant-days</b>"]

    B2["Chest position<br/>157 participants<br/><b>1249 participant-days</b>"]

    B3["Wrist position<br/>153 participants<br/><b>1223 participant-days</b>"]

    C["Concurrent coverage across all wear positions<br/>110 participants<br/><b>849 participant-days</b>"]

    D["Non-wear and out-of-range observations excluded<br/>110 participants<br/><b>845 participant-days</b>"]

    E1["Observations missing contextual data and days with continuous zero readings excluded<br/>108 participants<br/><b>787 participant-days</b>"]

    E2["Partial days excluded:<br/>- Hours with &lt; 50% data<br/>- Days with &lt; 80% data<br/>106 participants<br/><b>604 participant-days</b>"]
    
    F1["Contextual classification: Environment<br/>108 participants<br/><b>782 participant-days</b>"]
    
    F2["Contextual classification: Activity<br/>108 participants<br/><b>778 participant-days</b>"]
    
    F3["Contextual classification: Indoor work lighting<br/>105 participants<br/><b>545 participant-days</b>"]
    
    F4["Participant-day level metrics<br/>52 metrics per participant-day<br/><b>n = 31,408</b>"]

    F5["Participant-level metrics<br/>2 metrics per participant<br/><b>n = 212</b>"]

    A --> B1 & B2 & B3
    B1 & B2 & B3 --> C
    C --> D
    D -->| <b> measurement-level </b> | E1    
    D -->| <b> outcome-level </b> | E2
    E1 --> F1 & F2 & F3
    E2 --> F4 & F5
    E2 ~~~ Z

    Z["&emsp;&emsp;&emsp;&emsp;&emsp;&emsp;&emsp;&emsp;&emsp;"]
    style Z fill:none,stroke:none,color:transparent
    
    classDef head  fill:#0073C2,color:#FFFFFF
    classDef chest fill:#EFC000,color:#FFFFFF
    classDef wrist fill:#868686,color:#FFFFFF

    class B1 head
    class B2 chest
    class B3 wrist

```

```{r}
#| label: export-flowchart-png
#| eval: false
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Export flowchart to PNG"

# Renders the Mermaid diagram above to output/figures/method_flowchart.png
# via a temporary HTML file and webshot2 (headless Chrome).
# Run manually when the diagram changes.

library(webshot2)

mermaid_code <- '%%{init: {"flowchart": {"padding": 8, "nodeSpacing": 30, "rankSpacing": 40, "diagramPadding": 4}} }%%
flowchart TD

    A["Study sample<br/>191 participants<br/>× 8 protocol days<br/><b>1528 participant-days</b>"]

    B1["Eye-level position<br/>143 participants<br/><b>1136 participant-days</b>"]

    B2["Chest position<br/>157 participants<br/><b>1249 participant-days</b>"]

    B3["Wrist position<br/>153 participants<br/><b>1223 participant-days</b>"]

    C["Concurrent coverage across all wear positions<br/>110 participants<br/><b>849 participant-days</b>"]

    D["Non-wear and out-of-range observations excluded<br/>110 participants<br/><b>845 participant-days</b>"]

    E1["Observations missing contextual data and days with continuous zero readings excluded<br/>108 participants<br/><b>787 participant-days</b>"]

    E2["Partial days excluded:<br/>- Hours with < 50% data<br/>- Days with < 80% data<br/>106 participants<br/><b>604 participant-days</b>"]
    
    F1["Contextual classification: Environment<br/>108 participants<br/><b>782 participant-days</b>"]
    
    F2["Contextual classification: Activity<br/>108 participants<br/><b>778 participant-days</b>"]
    
    F3["Contextual classification: Indoor work lighting<br/>105 participants<br/><b>545 participant-days</b>"]
    
    F4["Participant-day level metrics<br/>52 metrics per participant-day<br/><b>n = 31,408</b>"]

    F5["Participant-level metrics<br/>2 metrics per participant<br/><b>n = 212</b>"]

    A --> B1 & B2 & B3
    B1 & B2 & B3 --> C
    C --> D
    D -->| <b> measurement-level </b> | E1    
    D -->| <b> outcome-level </b> | E2
    E1 --> F1 & F2 & F3
    E2 --> F4 & F5
    E2 ~~~ Z

    Z["&emsp;&emsp;&emsp;&emsp;&emsp;&emsp;&emsp;&emsp;&emsp;"]
    style Z fill:none,stroke:none,color:transparent
    
    classDef head  fill:#0073C2,color:#FFFFFF
    classDef chest fill:#EFC000,color:#FFFFFF
    classDef wrist fill:#868686,color:#FFFFFF

    class B1 head
    class B2 chest
    class B3 wrist'

html_content <- sprintf('<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <style>
    body { margin: 0; padding: 20px; background: white; display: flex; justify-content: center; }
    .mermaid { font-family: sans-serif; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="mermaid">
%s
  </div>
  <script type="module">
    import mermaid from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@11/dist/mermaid.esm.min.mjs";
    mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: true, theme: "default" });
  </script>
</body>
</html>', mermaid_code)

tmp_html <- tempfile(fileext = ".html")
writeLines(html_content, tmp_html)

webshot(
  tmp_html,
  file     = here::here("output/figures/method_flowchart.png"),
  delay    = 3,
  zoom     = 16,
  vwidth   = 4800,
  selector = ".mermaid"
)
```
